_meta.purpose: Single source of truth for how the five requested topics map onto Kalshi's published taxonomy. Read by scripts/collect.py, scripts/analyze.py and site/assets/kalshi.js so the collector and the dashboard can never disagree.
_meta.matching_rule: A topic is the union of its selectors. /series matches `category` against any entry of a series' `categories` list, and `tags` exactly and case-sensitively. Source: https://docs.kalshi.com/api-reference/market/get-series-list.md
_meta.prefix_rule: ticker_prefixes is a fast path for classifying a market ticker from the tape when a series lookup is unavailable. Membership is always confirmed by a /series or /events read before being published; prefix-only rows are labelled 'provisional'.
_meta.unmapped: Kalshi publishes no 'Culture' category and no retail-gasoline category. See docs/questions.md Q-02 and FLAG-03.

topics.label: Gas & energy prices
topics.note: No retail/pump gasoline category exists in the published taxonomy; the official proxies are crude and natural-gas series (WTI, Brent, Henry-TTF natural gas, heating oil) plus the Economics tag 'Oil and energy'. Confirm intended instrument in Q-02.

topics.label: Elections
topics.note: Elections is a first-class Kalshi category; individual races appear as tags on it.

topics.label: Culture & entertainment
topics.note: SUBSTITUTION (FLAG-03): Kalshi has no 'Culture' category. 'Entertainment' is the closest official grouping and covers Person-of-the-Year, film/TV/music awards, charts and game sales.

topics.label: Crypto
topics.note: Crypto is a first-class category and carries fifteen_min / hourly cadences, which is why it dominates the raw tape.

topics.label: Golf
topics.note: Golf is a *tag* under Sports, not a category. Query /series?category=Sports&tags=Golf.
